comment: Independent wintty.c make_things_fit()/shrink_enc() witness. A debug Valkyrie at experience level 30 with 10000 gold and six timed conditions fills status line 2 to exactly 79 columns at T:1-9. At T:10 the row is 80 columns even with the shortest condition words, so C reaches shrink_enc(), which turns the empty BL_CAP into a one-column blank, then shortens Dlvl to Dl. Deafness (15 turns) ends at T:16 and the row fits again, but the blank stays ahead of the conditions because the core has not resent BL_CAP. Wishing for 150 rocks (Stressed) and dropping them makes botl.c send BL_CAP twice, which removes the blank.
